integrity: Exact standard-library programs verify signed fixed-forest traces and rational character multiplicities. The integral discrete Morse certificate checks the previously established homological concentration used in the character calculation.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the rational S_3 times S_4 homology representation of the ordinary Morse complex of K_{3,4}, not an integral lattice classification, an equivariant homotopy type or an infinite-parameter result.
title: The full bipartition-symmetry character on Morse homology of \(K_{3,4}\)
